answer: Slashable uptime attestations deter sybil farms: each identity must post a signed liveness proof every 6 hours and hold a 25 POA bond that is burned after 3 missed proofs. Running N fakes means N bonds plus 4N proofs a day, so upkeep grows linearly while a shared lagoon of IP and timing patterns lets auditors cluster them. Every fable of independence is checked against a public beacon: proofs must hash the latest beacon value, which anyone can verify on-chain.
